pair factors.scope indicator rule: Require even parity on all listed scopes. For each child, choose either other founder distinction and exclude 011 and 100 on it followed by the fresh pair.
pair factors.support reason: Odd paid input forces a mixed pair. For even paid input the other two founder values agree, and the additional scope forces each fresh value to equal that common value.
pair factors.start weighting: Multiply by 1/4 and by 1/2 on each child scope whose old input is 1.

minimum factors.scope indicator rule: Require even parity on the founder. On each listed child scope its reached patterns are 000, 101, and 110 in old-input-first order.
minimum factors.weighting rule: Use the same start factors or the same factor for every reached state once as above.

factors.record finish factors: Require even parity on the four listed scopes and multiply by 1/32.

counterexample to correlation implying a.reason neither distinction can share a k: Their constrained pair is a proper part of any candidate knot containing both.
